scope: Independent adversarial code review of build-go W1 pilot; issues & gaps identified and fixed with TDD
findings_fixed: FATAL BUG: hash.lossyUTF8 failed WHATWG maximal subpart decoding on truncated invalid continuation bytes (swallowed trailing ASCII bytes) and 3/4-byte sequences (emitted extra U+FFFDs); replaced with standard WHATWG maximal subpart algorithm, verified against Node on [0xe0, 0x28], [0xe2, 0x82, 0x28, 0x61], [0xf0, 0x90, 0x80, 0x28]

GAP: hash.CanonicalJSON decoded numbers to float64, losing precision on large 64-bit integers and high-precision numbers; switched to json.NewDecoder with UseNumber() and strict io.EOF verification for trailing data

GAP: sidecar.AssetPath allowed hidden/dot files (e.g. dir/.js, .css) because len(bundle) > len(ext); updated to check filepath.Base(bundle) length exceeding ext, matching JS regex match(/(.+)\.(?:js|css)$/)

GAP: config.Config special-cased vendorPrefix null but lost null for all other optional fields (restNamespace, batchEndpoint, etc.), converting them to empty strings; generalized to NullFields map[string]bool
GAP: phpencode.encode rejected json.Number, float32, uint/int8/int16, and map[string]string; added full numeric and map[string]string support with tests
ROBUSTNESS: covercheck.parseBlock failed on Windows paths containing drive letters (e.g. C:\...); fixed to split on whitespace first then use LastIndex for range separator colon
USABILITY: cli.go printHelp misstated sidecar syntax as <file.css|file.js> when WriteStyle is strictly for stylesheets; corrected to <file.css>

verification.binary_e2e: wpdev-build hash and config verified against live repository files

commands: cd packages/build-go && go vet ./... && gofmt -l . && go test -count=1 ./... && go test -count=1 -race -shuffle=on ./... && go test -count=1 -coverprofile=coverage.out ./...
